cohort: The study included 62 sets of twins (124 babies) admitted to the PNC ward, NICU, or identified as IUD babies at a tertiary care hospital in Ahmedabad, India, between January 1, 2022, and December 31, 2022.
finding: The primary finding was that 57.25% of neonates in twin pregnancies required admission to the NICU for complication management, and a majority were low birth weight babies with a mean weight of 1.7 kg.
mod_finding: Most of the twin deliveries were performed by Lower Segment Caesarean Section (LSCS) at term gestation.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively from case histories for events occurring at or shortly after birth, covering a one-year period from January 1, 2022 to December 31, 2022.
birth_weight: Majority were low birth weight babies, with a mean weight of 1.7 kg.
gest_age: Most deliveries occurred at term gestation, though prematurity was noted as a complication among neonates.
